enabled.description: Enable the daily summary rule set. Set to false to disable without deleting the file.

items.description: A regular expression pattern to exclude from matches. Lines matching ANY exclude pattern are ignored. Patterns are case-insensitive by default.

exclude_patterns.description: List of regex patterns to filter OUT (ignore) from daily reports.

items.description: A regular expression pattern to include in matches. Only lines matching AT LEAST ONE include pattern are reported (unless all excluded first). Patterns are case-sensitive by default.

include_patterns.description: List of regex patterns to include in daily reports (only lines matching these are reported).

sort_output.description: Sort output by pattern group for stable ordering (recommended for cron reporting).

sample_limit.description: Maximum number of sample log lines to show per matched pattern group.

items.description: An email address to receive the daily logcheck summary.

report_email.description: List of recipients for the daily email report.

report_subject_prefix.description: Prefix added to the subject line of the daily email report.

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging to syslog (useful for debugging the rule matching logic).
